notes.title: Succubus Cafe January Game Production Progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone, what I want to tell you in this progress report is as follows

1. Game progress
The dubbing work is currently underway. After discussing with the voice actors, the voices of all the girls will be completed around mid-March.
But after receiving the sound file, there are follow-up expression animations that need to be made (synchronized with the sound).
Now I will ask the voice actors to complete a girl, and then give me the file first, so that the voice actors and I can execute it simultaneously.
The remaining gaps will enhance the details of the game. (Currently, we have started to make the emoji of one of the girls)

2. Time to market
Everyone is most concerned about the time to market. I cannot guarantee that it will be released in a few months. Maybe there will be problems in production.
However, the current rough estimate may be able to go on the market from mid-April to mid-May.

3. The perfect lover update
During this period of time, I received many requests for updates, and I have recorded the content, and will come back to update after I concentrate on completing the new work.
It has not been updated for a long time, I hope you can understand, because I am the only one making animation and various game functions.
Next, I will plan the time arrangement more carefully (maybe the development time will be a little longer, or look for partners to cooperate), please give me more time to plan, I will continue to maintain the good places, and I will keep the shortcomings. Will improve, welcome your comments.

4. Dubbing and subtitles
The new work will have two voices, English and Japanese, with subtitles in English, Japanese, Chinese (simplified), and Chinese (traditional).
According to different languages, it will make expressions corresponding to different languages. (Different voices should have different feelings)

5. Achievements and cloud storage (Steam Cloud and Steam Achievement)
At present, there are already achievements and cloud storage functions in the game, but before going online, I will test it again (I use Steam Cloud and Steam Achievement for the first time).
This time there will be no level issue. For user convenience, the game directly unlocks all content.
Cloud storage is only convenient for players to record favorite clothing settings and game settings.

6. Part of the game content display
a. I have received a lot of settings for a variety of stockings a while ago, and there are already several types of stockings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/22b1d67be5fbc71f57afb5ef6724178b6bccc98b.jpg[/img]

b. This time you can use props on the girl (some poses will be restricted), and props also have different moves and speeds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/7b289351611e66872a51bf837d7d6ed598d74cce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/ef6522d99a90ba1b4ee7baf42679cf5a465e0bcd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/0f6335a05683f5ad7e621ef155c082132d999771.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/aabc8f52fbc3ac4121139534c5d6d26f8393bef4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/fc35b311c54e83b9679c7628de859bf83905a7a0.jpg[/img]

c. Each pose allows the player to decide whether to have a single girl or two girls. Both girls can use props and switch costumes
(Currently the male face has not been completed yet)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/f47ff4b76502d5769d29d307631cb27b4701b410.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/887d40158805914622a8d7cdd07e0095c974d932.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/efb2dc651c19a5c25735624d9d823b70384c21e6.jpg[/img]

d. I increased the details of the scene to make the scenery outside the window more in line with the theme, and also adjusted the atmosphere a little
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/3ca3c696cda9d98fd7156bea1b4536344d667883.jpg[/img]

e. The semen expression method, this time it will be presented by other methods (to avoid some AMD CPUs that cannot use this function and cause a crash)

7. Price adjustment
The price of the new game will be adjusted after calculating the cost and content. This time the game content is about 2~3 times that of the perfect girlfriend, including actions and lines, etc. The price will increase by about 30%~50% (for example, 10 $> 13$~15$).

Thank you for your support and encouragement during this period. I will read all the bad reviews. As long as I can tell me what you think, I will try my best to overcome it.
This time the report is all pictures (I used all the time to make emoticons XD). Since the remaining work is left with the animation of emoticons, the game can be put on the shelves, so the next monthly report will be suspended. The next time The news reappeared, it was the announcement of the game's launch.

Thank you again for your waiting. I will continue to maintain the good places and improve on the shortcomings. Your suggestions are welcome.

notes.title: Succubus Cafe November Game Production Progress
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. Since October and November are working on character animation, the progress report will not be released until the end of November. Please bear with me.
Now all parts of the character animation have been made, and the total length of the animation is about 21 minutes (about 37,000 frames).
The following is part of the animation display (the screen and part of the model will be modified), and the main screen of the game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146479/588c002444f8a5e6db59395270c130c5bd746936.png[/img]

https://twitter.com/i/status/1332913063847030785

Next, I will make the final stage, the following is the unfinished part.
1. Design dialogues (dirty talk, character lines)
2. Translation, dubbing
3. Right mouth shape (make the character's mouth shape match the voice of the dubbing)
4. Optimize the final picture
5.UI design
I expect the above work to be completed in two months, which is December and January.

I originally planned to launch [Succubus Cafe] at the end of 2020, but I did not achieve this goal. I am very sorry to all of you.
I will finish the remaining work as soon as possible, but the quality of the game will be prioritized.

I have also received comments and criticisms from many players for [PerfectLover]. After completing [Succubus Cafe], I will start to optimize some of the problems of [PerfectLover].

This year, I am very grateful to the players for their support. I will try my best to improve the comments and criticisms received. I will continue to maintain the good points and improve on the deficiencies. Your suggestions are welcome.

notes.title: Succubus Cafe September game production progress
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, this month's progress report was released a little late, so please bear with me.

Here I would like to inform you of some game content and some adjustments.

1. In the last progress report, many players responded to me that they prefer females to serve players and don’t like so many male characters.
I temporarily suspended the production of the animations of multiple men, and redesigned the animations of multiple girls. Players can decide which two girls to play in the 3P game, and also modify most of the actions to be more intense. The following are most of the actions Screenshots, and dynamic display.
